subject: R24_PHYSICAL_HOST_EVIDENCE_VERIFIER

fault.description: Current verifier can return VERIFIED from structurally valid synthetic attestations without externally anchored trust over attestation roots.
fault.impact: VERIFIED is stronger than the evidence actually established by the verifier contract.

required_correction: separate structural qualification from physical verification
require explicit external trust source for accepted attestation roots
retain physical_multi_host promotion REJECTED until actual distinct-host execution, rollback, fault-injection and independent verification exist
